newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to cooperate with G7 on forex if needed -- Jiji.
newsitem.headline: MOF to cooperate with G7 on forex if needed -- Jiji.

text.p: Japan will cooperate with the Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations in the foreign exchange market if necessary, Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's international finance bureau, was quoted as saying on Thursday by Jiji news agency.

"Our position that excessive yen weakness is unfavourable remains unchanged. So, we would like to keep watch over market movements and act in cooperation with G7 nations if necessary," Sakakibara was quoted as saying at a parliamentary committee.
He also said that foreign exchange rates had stabilised after a currency agreement reached by G7 finance ministers and central bankers in Berlin earlier this month, Jiji said.
